name: altocue
description: The AI edit suite for coding agents: footage, a long recording or a brief in, a finished and checked video out.

interface.shortDescription: Raw footage in. Finished video out.
interface.longDescription: Altocue gives your agent a full video edit suite on your own machine. It cuts silence, fillers and retakes from word-timed transcripts, cleans the sound, corrects colour, reframes, captions, adds motion graphics and sound you are allowed to use, and delivers a version for each platform. It also makes launch films and explainers with no footage. A separate Editor in Chief reviews the result, and code decides SHIP or FIX.
defaultPrompt: Edit take.mov into a 45 second reel for first-time founders.
Make a launch video for my product.
Check whether this machine can run Altocue.
